entry_points.summary: Durable registry of 14 system-level behavioral invariants (inv_001–inv_014), schema v1
JSON Schema draft-2020-12 for one invariant entry; 11 fields, additionalProperties:false
Validate INVARIANTS.json: id-uniqueness, tag-subset, fixture non-triviality; exits 0/1/2/3
Checks fixture_schema for at least one constraining keyword (enum/required/minItems/etc.)
Limited but practical JSON Schema validator for fixture_defaults vs fixture_schema
CI gate: coverage check (blocker uncovered=exit 3), test-suite run, optional full-chain pass

invariants: INVARIANTS.json is user-authored and optional — absence is normal, not a bug; both z-test and z-review-all degrade gracefully
All writes to INVARIANTS.json must be atomic: tempfile → flush → fsync → os.replace() (inv_003)
tags[] must be a subset of the controlled tag set in docs/llm/TAGS.txt; validate-invariants.py enforces this at write time
fixture_defaults is only valid when fixture_schema is also present (constraint exit 2, not schema-enforced)
id format is inv_NNN (3-digit zero-padded); once assigned, never reused — deprecate rather than recycle
sighting_count/last_sighting/anchor_module are optional review-run fields; absence means the invariant has never been triggered in a review
gotchas: docs/INVARIANTS.md is a stale rendered view (shows 8 entries); docs/INVARIANTS.json is canonical (14 entries)
inv_006 source_files reference pre-migration export paths (exports/export-pi.py, scripts/export-codex-skills.py) that no longer exist — behavioral property is still valid but source_files are stale
invariant-check.sh auto-discovers TESTS.md under z-harness/plans/*/ and plans/*/; non-standard plan dirs require --tests-file
z-test v2 path requires INVARIANTS.json present; absence triggers v1 fallback (SPEC.md/INTENT.md extraction only, no stable inv_NNN IDs in TESTS.md)
New tags must be added to TAGS.txt before being used in INVARIANTS.json entries — validate-invariants.py will reject unknown tags with exit 2
